hypothesis: With delayed delivery, sufficient detected beat coverage guarantees that estimates remain within 3 bpm of the full-window reference.
rival: When delivery truncates the window's changing rate, error depends on ramp direction. Sufficient beat coverage can coexist with a biased estimate.
historical_scope: Superseding an extrapolation from the archived result, not revising the archived result or attributing this new hypothesis to its model.
design: Matched timely versus three-second delayed delivery of identical acquired samples. Compare rising, falling and constant rate. Measure ungated candidate error and the existing freshness gate separately.
discovery_rule: At least one delayed sufficient-coverage candidate exceeds the error bound.
replication_rule: For at least 75% of seeds jointly, every paired candidate has sufficient coverage, timely and constant delayed candidates are within the error bound, rising delayed error is below -3 bpm, falling delayed error exceeds +3 bpm, and the freshness gate withholds every delayed candidate.
uncertainty: Exact two-sided 95% binomial interval for the joint replication success, one Bernoulli outcome per seed, conditional on this simulator.

memory_evaluation.fixtures: 24 disjoint synthetic cases from six predefined task families, generated from the published fixed seed; subject and sources randomized; expected answers derived from fixture semantics before retrieval.
memory_evaluation.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals across fixture cases; shared fixture grammar limits external validity.
memory_evaluation.interpretation: Compare structural capabilities in a controlled benchmark, with the same lexical ranker and no language model. Timing and space are descriptive. No claim against the full previous production architecture.

limits: Host-authored prospective experiment and hypotheses. Computational replication within one team and one detector, with disjoint seeds and two waveforms. No clinical or organism data.
